scoring_justification: The paper reports only qualitative trends (domain size decreases with increasing k and increases with increasing T_q) and no exact numerical targets; scoring is based on verifying these structural relationships and MCS consistency.

outputs.description: Domain size measures (FZC, k1) for three simulation conditions, used to verify structural ordering trends consistent with the physical dependencies of domain size on reaction speed and quench temperature.

output_contract.notes: The simulation is compute-intensive; the agent may run on external compute and return the final analyzed CSV. Verification checks the ordering of FZC_mean and k1_mean, not absolute values.

steps.description: Verify MCS correctness and ordering trends for FZC and k1 across the three conditions.
